description: Format Memly files after Codex applies a patch.

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && find program -type f \( -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.hpp' -o -name '*.h' \) -print0 | xargs -0 clang-format -i
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && git ls-files -z '*.md' '*.markdown' | xargs -0 npx --yes prettier@3.9.6 --write
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && git ls-files -z '*.yaml' '*.yml' .clang-tidy | xargs -0 npx --yes prettier@3.9.6 --write
